description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger' implementing an auto-closeable, thread-unsafe SLF4J logger wrapper with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management. It provides various logging methods delegating to an SLF4J 'Logger', along with MDC handling for correlation IDs and thread safety considerations.

classes.name: DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, auto-closeable wrapper for SLF4J Logger with MDC management, allowing context-aware logging with correlation IDs and MDC entries.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of the logger wrapper with a specified SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying SLF4J logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message with MDC context if enabled.

methods.name: tryToPutLocalMdcToActualMdc
methods.description: Attempts to synchronize local MDC entries to the SLF4J MDC, handling potential concurrent modification exceptions.

methods.name: putLocalMdcToActualMdc
methods.description: Copies all local MDC entries to the actual SLF4J MDC.

methods.name: handleConcurrentModificationException
methods.description: Logs a warning when concurrent modification of MDC entries occurs.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID in MDC for tracing purposes.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an MDC entry with a specified key and value.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes all local MDC entries from actual MDC and clears local entries, releasing resources.
